items.example: My friends talked me into going to the gig.
items.exampleTr: Arkadaşlarım beni konsere gitmeye ikna etti.
items.simple: Someone talks to you until you say yes.

items.example: She talked me out of buying that jacket.
items.simple: Someone talks to you until you say no to a plan.

items.example: We need to reach a compromise on the price.
items.exampleTr: Fiyat konusunda bir uzlaşmaya varmamız lazım.
items.simple: Each person gives a little, so both are happy enough.

items.example: How about we meet halfway? Say fifty pounds?
items.exampleTr: Ortada buluşsak mı? Mesela elli pound?
items.simple: Each of us moves a little, so we agree in the middle.
items.note: Hem fiziksel hem fikir olarak ortada buluşmak.

items.example: Fifty quid and it's yours. - That's a deal!
items.simple: You say this to say yes to a plan and finish talking.

items.example: That's my final price. Take it or leave it.
items.exampleTr: Son fiyat bu. Ya al ya bırak.
items.simple: This is the only offer. There is no other one.

items.example: Twenty each, and let's call it a deal.
items.simple: You say you both agree and the talking is over.

items.example: She drives a hard bargain, so be ready.
items.simple: You do not give in. You want a very good price for yourself.

items.en: Is there any room for negotiation?
items.example: Is there any room for negotiation on the rent?
items.simple: You ask if the person can change the price a little.

items.en: That's as far as I can go.
items.example: I can go to forty, but that's as far as I can go.
items.exampleTr: Kırka kadar çıkabilirim ama gidebileceğim en uç bu.
items.simple: You say the most you will pay or give.

items.example: Ten pounds for the lot? You've got yourself a deal.
items.exampleTr: Hepsi on pound mı? Tamamdır, anlaştık.
items.simple: You happily agree to what someone offers you.

items.example: I'm not convinced this plan will work.
items.exampleTr: Bu planın işe yarayacağına pek ikna olmadım.
items.simple: You do not believe it yet.

items.example: Hear me out before you say no.
items.exampleTr: Hayır demeden önce bir dinle beni.
items.simple: You ask someone to listen to everything before they decide.

items.example: Think about it. It could really help us.
items.simple: You ask someone to use their mind before they say no.

items.example: He's too stubborn to say sorry.
items.simple: A person who does not change their mind, even when others ask.

items.example: I finally gave in and let her have it.
items.exampleTr: Sonunda pes edip onun almasına izin verdim.
items.simple: You stop saying no and let the other person win.

items.example: His jokes won everyone over.
items.simple: You make someone like you or your idea.

items.example: I'll make an offer on the flat tomorrow.
items.simple: You say how much you will pay for something.

items.example: We finally struck a deal on the car.
items.simple: After talking, two people agree and it is done.

items.example: I'll do the dishes if you cook tonight.
items.exampleTr: Bu akşam sen yemek yaparsan bulaşığı ben yaparım.
items.simple: You offer one thing and ask for another thing back.

items.example: Let's not get carried away. It's just an idea.
items.simple: Do not go too far or get too excited.

items.en: I see where you're coming from.
items.example: I see where you're coming from, but I disagree.
items.exampleTr: Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama katılmıyorum.
items.simple: You understand why the person thinks this.

items.example: She stood her ground and wouldn't lower the price.
items.simple: You do not change your mind, even if others push you.
